blurb: Dogwood Golf Club is a semi-private facility in West Marietta, open to the public Monday-Thursday and selected times Friday-Saturday. Amenities include a driving range, practice green, grille, and a fully stocked pro shop. The club offers competitive membership categories and hosts golf outings and events.
